What the brief shows in favor: the coin is classed ORGANIC, not a factory launch, and the early tape looks broad. Roughly 457 buyers ex-agent in the first two minutes after graduation, with top-5 buyer share at 11%, suggests no single wallet dominated entry. Over the last 15 minutes, net flow is positive (+5.6 SOL), the return is +39%, and 18 buyers came in against 16 sellers. Bundle share of 29% is not extreme.

Why it doesn't hold up: the 30-minute return is -87% and the drawdown from the 30-minute high is 88%. The last-15-minute bounce sits on top of a collapse, and with sell-to-buy at 1.10 in the launch window, early buyers were already exiting. Only 18 buyers in the recent window is a sharp drop in participation, and the pool is just 35.8 SOL deep, so a $20 round trip would eat several percent in impact. Demand that has fallen 88% from its high is not evidence it will persist for the next 30-60 minutes.

My recommendation is to skip. The one-bounce signal is not enough to beat the base rate of losses on coins in this age window.
